record.paper_title: XXX Spin Chain: from Bethe Solution to Open Problems
record.original_question: For the antiferromagnetic spin-1/2 Heisenberg XXX spin chain, correlation functions are known to be expressible as polynomials in ln 2 and in values of the Riemann zeta function at odd arguments, equivalently in the alternating zeta series at odd arguments, with rational coefficients. Find an efficient explicit description of those rational coefficients that appear in these polynomial formulas for the XXX spin-chain correlation functions.

evidence.quote: However we still not have explicit expressions for the rational coefficients that enter in the expression for the correlation functions as polynomials in ln 2 and Riemann zeta function at odd arguments. Such a description will provide a tractable formula for the correlations of the XXX spin chain.

Open problem: Efficient description of the rational coefficients which appear in the expression for the correlation functions of the XXX spin chain as a polynomial in alternating zeta series at odd arguments.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the antiferromagnetic spin-1/2 Heisenberg XXX chain on the infinite one-dimensional lattice, with Hamiltonian
H = -J Σ_{n∈ℤ} ( S^x_n S^x_{n+1} + S^y_n S^y_{n+1} + S^z_n S^z_{n+1} - 1/4 ),
where S^{x,y,z}_n = (1/2)σ^{x,y,z}_n are spin-1/2 operators at site n. Let ⟨ · ⟩ denote the expectation value in the unique translation-invariant ground state at zero temperature and zero magnetic field. For each finite-range local operator built from spin operators on consecutive sites, the corresponding ground-state correlation function is known to admit a representation as a polynomial, with rational coefficients, in ln 2 and in the values ζ(3), ζ(5), ζ(7), … of the Riemann zeta function at odd integer arguments (equivalently, in the alternating zeta series ζ_a(2k+1) = Σ_{n≥1} (-1)^{n-1}/n^{2k+1} at odd arguments).

Problem. Provide an efficient explicit description (e.g., a closed-form combinatorial rule, generating function, or algorithm of polynomial complexity in the support size of the operator) of the rational coefficients that appear in these polynomial expressions for the ground-state correlation functions of the XXX spin chain.
artifact.category_tag: XXX Heisenberg spin chain correlation functions
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is widely treated as open. Correlation functions of the XXX chain are known/conjectured to be polynomials in ln 2 and ζ(odd) with rational coefficients, and have been computed explicitly for short ranges (up to about n=6–8), but no efficient closed-form description of the rational coefficients in general has been established. Subsequent work (e.g., Boos–Jimbo–Miwa–Smirnov–Takeyama, and SoV-based approaches such as Maillet–Niccoli 2020) gives structural/factorized representations but does not provide an explicit combinatorial description of the rational coefficients themselves.

status_evidence.snippet: We still do not have explicit expressions for the rational coefficients that enter in the expression for the correlation functions as polynomials in ln 2 and Riemann zeta function at odd arguments.
status_evidence.claim: The efficient description of these rational coefficients is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Correlation functions by Separation of Variables: the XXX spin chain
status_evidence.snippet: New approach to correlation functions of the XXX chain via Separation of Variables.
status_evidence.claim: Recent works give structural representations but not an efficient explicit form of the rational coefficients.
